mods.name: Fortress Duel
mods.description: 向任意玩家發起挑戰，就地框出 n×n 競技場，各自守著一圈可以牽走藏起來的熊貓：建造階段蓋牆、攻擊階段互轟，先把對方的熊貓全部打死者獲勝。怪物、武器、突發事件皆以 YAML 設定。

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* 停火階段、全彈藥射程保證，以及不浪費時間的工具 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/25
* 開場公告場地尺寸 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/26
* 建材變硬、黑曜石下架、攻擊階段可以補牆 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/27
* 斷線寬限：等人重連，不再一離線就判負 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/28
* 礦工與農夫：花錢雇工人，他們自己去挖礦、種田 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/29
* 模組化彈藥：買材料、自己組、交給軍火商量產 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/31
* 音樂家：一個只賣歌的商人 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/30
* Develop by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/32


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/compare/v0.3.0-alpha...v0.4.0-alpha

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* 修正對戰結束瞬間彈丸清單的 ConcurrentModificationException by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/8
* 修正擊退繞過傷害否決、窒息傷害改用明確旗標辨識 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/10
* 武器改成「一把弓 + 副手換彈藥實物」 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/12
* 隕石雨：實作 action: meteor，落一批 TNT by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/13
* 連射武器改成按住右鍵持續擊發 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/14
* 三個修正：物資回收、商店的弓、彈道顏色 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/15
* 開場清空背包（結束原封不動還他）＋ 軍火商賣工具 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/16
* develop → main：熊貓目標、單弓＋副手彈藥、三區塊限制、武器手感 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/9
* 平衡：補散彈、加木頭與鐵塊、穿甲彈改成剋鐵、罰款與賞金調整 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/17
* 事件效果、中場生態、彈道與分裂的一輪修正 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/18
* 鼠疫改成會爬牆的黑鼠，只啃得穿薄材料 by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/19
* Develop by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/20
* 玻璃盒邊界、開場清空、時間天氣鎖定，以及一連串定位修正 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/22
* 平衡調整、後座力修復，以及可移動的軍火商 by @j9263178 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/23
* Develop by @XinBow99 in https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XinBow99/MinecraftFarbicFortress/compare/v0.2.0-alpha...v0.3.0-alpha

readmeSummary: Minecraft Fabric mod（1.26.2 / Fabric Loader 0.19.3）。玩家可以向任意玩家發起挑戰，接受後雙方被傳送到附近框出來的 n×n 競技場，各自守著一座烽火台核心——建造階段蓋牆、攻擊階段互轟，先摧毀對方核心者獲勝。
